description: This file defines the ValidateProjectNameAPI class, an API endpoint for validating project name uniqueness in the OrangeHRM Time module. It handles GET requests to verify if a project name is available, potentially considering project ID and customer ID parameters.

classes.name: ValidateProjectNameAPI

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles the GET request to validate if a project name is available, optionally considering project ID and customer ID. Returns a result indicating whether the project name can be changed.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
